full_judgment: 3. The defendants appeared in the suit and filled written statement denying most of the allegations of the plaint stating, inter-alia, that the suit is barred by limitation, bad for defect of parties and the suit is also hit by principles of estoppels, waiver and acquiescence. The defendant's case, in-short, is that the defendant No. 4 published an advertisement for appointment Assistant Teacher in Primary School throughout in Bangladesh in which the plaintiff applied for the post of Assistant Teacher without putting his signature in the original application and, as such, the defendant No. 4 rightly cancelled the appointment letter by his order dated 9-5-2009. The suit is liable to be dismissed.
